newsitem.title: USA: Dow pares losses in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Dow pares losses in late trading.

text.p: U.S. stocks pared their losses in late trading on Thursday.
The Dow was down about 151 points, or 2.2 percent, after tumbling over 200 points.
The Nasdaq composite was off 19 at 1249, recovering from its low of 1241.

Analysts attributed the day's decline to market concern over rising interest rates, and the prospect for competition for stocks from bonds. The long bond closed off 1-8/32, its yield rising to 7.09 percent.
